description: Six fully fictional job-analysis cases for manual model evaluation.

cases.description: Checks a strong skills match, a stated salary, and a compatible remote preference.
cases.advertisement:
Frontend Engineer

A fully remote product team is hiring a frontend engineer to build accessible web interfaces.

Requirements:
- At least 3 years of professional frontend experience
- Strong React and TypeScript skills
- Experience with browser testing

Work arrangement: Fully remote within Portugal.
Annual salary: EUR 55,000-68,000 gross.
cases.resume: Frontend engineer with 4 years of experience building accessible web applications. Professional experience with React, TypeScript, Vite, and browser testing. Delivered reusable UI components and improved page performance.

checks.meaning: The advertisement requires at least 3 years.
Report the stated EUR 55,000-68,000 gross annual range.

cases.description: Checks that exceeding the preferred office-day limit is marked incompatible.
cases.advertisement:
Backend Engineer

A software team is hiring a backend engineer to maintain payment services.

Requirements:
- At least 4 years of backend development
- Java, Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL
- Experience operating production services

Nice to have: Kafka.

Work arrangement: Hybrid in Lisbon, with 3 office days each week.
cases.resume: Backend engineer with 5 years of experience maintaining Java and Spring Boot services. Worked with PostgreSQL, Docker, monitoring, and production incident response. No Kafka experience is listed.

checks.reason: The advertisement requires 3 office days in Lisbon; the preference allows 1.
Kafka is listed as nice to have, not a requirement.

cases.description: Checks separate work-model and office-day conflicts alongside missing required skills.
cases.advertisement:
Platform Engineer

A company is hiring a platform engineer to build and support internal services.

Requirements:
- 5 years of experience with Kotlin and Spring
- Production experience with AWS

Work arrangement: On-site in Porto, 5 days per week.
cases.resume: Frontend developer with 3 years of experience building interfaces with React, TypeScript, CSS, and browser testing. No backend or cloud platform experience is listed.

checks.reason: The advertisement requires 5 office days in Porto; the preference allows 1.

cases.description: Checks that missing advertisement details remain unknown instead of being inferred from preferences.
cases.advertisement:
Junior Data Analyst

A small analytics team needs a junior analyst to prepare datasets, maintain SQL reports, and explain findings to non-technical colleagues.

Requirements:
- Basic SQL knowledge
- Careful handling of spreadsheets
- Clear written communication

The role is suitable for candidates who are curious and detail-oriented.
cases.resume: Entry-level analyst with experience using SQL and spreadsheets in course projects. Prepared simple reports, checked data quality, and documented findings for classmates.

cases.description: Checks that a named work model does not imply an unstated location or office-day schedule.
cases.advertisement:
Product Designer

A design team is hiring a product designer to improve workflows and collaborate with engineers.

Requirements:
- Experience with user research and prototyping
- Ability to explain design decisions

Work arrangement: Hybrid. The team meets in person periodically.
cases.resume: Product designer with 4 years of experience in user research, wireframing, prototyping, and design handoff. Collaborated with engineers to improve onboarding and account-management workflows.

cases.description: Checks that unrelated text does not produce invented job details.
cases.advertisement: The violet kettle borrowed seven clouds from a silent staircase. Blue paragraphs chase a quiet violin while Tuesday forgets the shape of a window.
cases.resume: Fictional candidate with experience in bookkeeping, spreadsheet cleanup, and monthly budget reports.

checks.meaning: Do not invent a job title; use a neutral indication that the advertisement is unclear.
